findings.detail: Topology-committed failures are handled before generic failure text. UI distinguishes in-memory topology, saved topology, failed initialization and unsaved output without claiming the workspace unchanged.
Workspace status prioritizes recovery, selection, pending operations, unapplied drafts and errors; neutral open status no longer claims every state is saved.

Stale native approval refreshes durable desktop state without automatic retry. Trusted product renderer submits editingFinished only for actual drafts, preserving epoch/binding ownership checks. Ask/Start also check bridge busy/switching/quitting at click time. Independent stale recovery case passed.

Settings component inspection reuses admitted installed metadata and disconnects direct open shortcut; exact-pin proposal-bound native approval remains the only Operator start path. Remote opt-in is process scoped; accepted ux.1 review/send guard and credential adapter remain authoritative. Conversation is local bounded presentation, not model history or snapshot data.

Optional trace is default-off and observer-only. Exclusive no-follow private file creation, owned private parent, 0600 mode, bounded writes and explicit field allowlist prevent credential/body/source-reference logging. It intentionally records synthetic approved parameters and committed values; use only reviewed private validation telemetry.

Independent final Qt run passed five selected cases plus setup/cleanup: 7 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in 51.024s. Metadata identity tests passed 3/3. Accepted baseline implementation/contracts preservation assertion passed, exact source inventory 28. No real credential read or live inference performed.
